paragraphs: Dive into a powerful research assistant that mines public data, leverages hedge‑fund–style analysis, and delivers actionable stock picks — all in one sleek, dark‑mode interface.
Watch the explainer video for full walkthrough: FULL SIMULATION
features: Scrapes recent public filings, insider‑trade data, institutional 13F reports and other stock‑market signals based on your custom prompts.
Runs advanced analysis via a locked LLM model, extracting the top 5 stock opportunities (or fewer, if data is limited).
For each recommendation, provides a clear Investment Duration: when to invest (entry) and when to sell (exit), plus short bull/bear rationale and risk notes.
Lets you chat with AURA about the results — ask follow‑up questions, get clarifications, or dive deeper into a stock’s thesis.
Uses public, up-to-date data; no paywalls or subscriptions required.
